name: aws_efs
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS EFS file system — an elastic, managed NFS file system provisioned within an environment and resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this EFS file system.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the EFS file system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description of the EFS file system.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the file system is provisioned.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the file system is provisioned.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: encryption
attributes.description: Encryption at rest mode. NoEncryption disables encryption; AwsManagedKey uses the AWS-managed EFS key; ResourceGroupKmsKey uses the resource group's KMS key. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: availability_zone_name
attributes.description: AWS Availability Zone to create a One Zone file system in (e.g. us-east-1a). Omit for a Regional (multi-AZ) file system. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: performance_mode
attributes.description: Performance mode: generalPurpose (default) or maxIO. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: creation_token
attributes.description: Idempotency token used at creation. Defaults to the file system name if omitted. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: backup
attributes.description: Whether to enable automatic backups (AWS Backup) at creation. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: throughput_mode
attributes.description: Throughput mode: bursting (default), provisioned, or elastic. Mutable.

attributes.name: provisioned_throughput_in_mibps
attributes.description: Provisioned throughput in MiB/s. Required when throughput_mode is provisioned; ignored otherwise.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags applied to the file system at creation.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Tag key.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Tag value.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the file system.

attributes.name: aws_efs_id
attributes.description: ID of this EFS file system resource, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: file_system_id
attributes.description: AWS ID of the provisioned file system (e.g. fs-0123456789abcdef0).

attributes.name: file_system_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned file system.

attributes.name: life_cycle_state
attributes.description: AWS lifecycle state of the file system (e.g. available, creating, deleting).
